description: The pinned practice rule of the pre-count (PLAN-DETAIL R6-3): one translator call and one adjudicator call on it, before any counted call, give the practice pair cost the projection uses. It is outside every stratum (not a plugin rule, not a control) and never enters a census record, a median or the scorer. It takes the same path as a plugin rule (plugin-surface, the same prompt builders and mechanical checks).
authorship: Written by the bundle-2 implementer lane; replaced after refute r1 (N5) and again after refute r2 (N10, the earlier heading rule overlapped a punctuation rule). It is a rule about image alt text in documents. No census rule's text names an image as a word, alt text or accessibility, and the practice rule shares no four-word sequence with any census rule's text; a committed test checks both.

rules.text: Every image in a document has alt text that says what the image shows.
rules.context: Checked on the text of one document.
